@@U03772@@
I’m astonished,
and should like to ask many questions.
Tell me why that good man’s speech
sounds so strange,
strange but also pleasing.
One sound seems to fit so well with the next,
and no sooner is one word settled in the ear
than along comes another to caress it.

@@U03774@@
It’s the way we speak.
But how much more our music will delight you.
Tt will move you to the very depths of your soul.
There’s nothing better than practice to teach you how.
Shall we begin?

@@U03776@@
Tell me, then,
how I can speak so charmingly.

@@U03778@@
That’s easily done.
You must simply speak from the heart.
And when the soul is touched with passion’s flame,
we look around and ask—

@@U03780@@
—who burns the same?

@@U03782@@
Neither past nor future has power to bless;
the present moment—

@@U03784@@
—is our happiness.

@@U03786@@
It’s treasure, wondrous gain, supreme command.
What gives it confirmation?’
translation:
@@U03772@@
我很惊讶，
并且想问很多问题。
告诉我为什么那个好人的演讲
听起来很奇怪，
奇怪但也令人愉快。
一种声音似乎与另一种声音非常契合，
一句话一落入耳中
然后另一个人来爱抚它。

@@U03774@@
这就是我们说话的方式。
但我们的音乐会让您更加高兴。
它会感动你到你灵魂的最深处。
没有什么比练习更能教你如何做到这一点了。
我们开始吧？

@@U03776@@
那么告诉我，
我怎么能说话这么迷人。

@@U03778@@
这很容易做到。
你必须只是发自内心地说话。
当灵魂被激情的火焰触动时，
我们环顾四周并询问——

@@U03780@@
——谁会燃烧同样的东西？

@@U03782@@
过去和未来都没有力量祝福；
当下——

@@U03784@@
——是我们的幸福。

@@U03786@@
是宝物，是奇妙的收获，是至高无上的命令。
是什么证实了这一点？
